verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a harness-agnostic library of agent skills and a bootstrap injector that runs inside other coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.). It does not host models or collect user data. Whether data is used for training is controlled by the underlying model provider or harness, so a training opt-out is a category error for this kind of plugin, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships one.
